name: database-workspace-shell
description: Multi-tier database and table editor workspace layout featuring primary service navigation rail, collapsible schema & entity explorer sidebar, secondary action toolbar, blank data stage, and resizable right inspector panel.

visual_references.name: Supabase Studio
visual_references.purpose: database and table editor with primary icon rail, secondary schema sidebar, and action toolbar

visual_references.name: Neon
visual_references.purpose: serverless database console with branch/table explorer and SQL stage

design_constraints: No hardcoded database schemas, SQL statements, or Postgres connection strings
Empty main stage container by default

source_provenance.neutralization_summary: Extracted database and table editor workspace shell from Supabase Studio layout architecture. Removed Postgres permissions, local storage queries, and Supabase client bindings in favor of clean React slots and standard CSS tokens.
